rows.title: Freelance Senior AI / Knowledge Graph Engineer (m/f/d) - REMOTE
rows.location: Remote (France listed); CET / Berlin timezone expected
rows.eligibility: Tier 1 - freelance/B2B engagement, fully remote inside CET, English fluent with German only nice-to-have; Venice sits in the required timezone
rows.comp: EUR 75,000-85,000 per year (freelance engagement; roughly EUR 300-340/day at 250 billable days)
rows.why: Applied-AI build work on production LLM pipelines (PydanticAI, LangChain, DSPy, Instructor) plus Python/PostgreSQL and workflow orchestration - the same shape as the CV-parsing and agent work he shipped at FlowSpace, and it is invoiced freelance, which is his normal mode. Explicitly not a research role, so no PhD gate.
rows.watch_outs: Asks 5+ years shipping data/AI systems against his ~3; graph databases (Neo4j/Neptune/ArangoDB) are the core of the role and he has no graph experience - he needs to lead with API-integration depth and fast codebase ramp-up. Location string says "Remote (France)", so confirm an Italian Partita IVA invoicer qualifies before investing in the practical assessment. German is listed as nice-to-have only.

rows.title: n8n Automation Specialist
rows.company: Licensed Behavior Analyst Professional Services (LBAPS) - posted on the OOS Management Corp Greenhouse board
rows.eligibility: Tier 3 - US company, physical Brooklyn location on the posting, and it is silent on remote work, contractors abroad, employer-of-record and US payroll. Basis is stated as "Full-Time / Contract", so the contract door is open even if the geography is not.
rows.comp: $45.00-$75.00 per hour, depending on experience and portfolio
rows.posted: not disclosed on the posting (fetched live 2026-08-05)
rows.why: The tightest stack match in the whole contract slice: n8n as the named platform, plus HubSpot, Mailchimp, Google/Meta Ads, REST APIs, webhooks and JSON - which is exactly his n8n + CRM lead-capture + Sendgrid/Google API work, and the GTM-automation angle he can evidence but most engineers cannot. No year count; they ask for a portfolio, which suits someone with no CS degree.
rows.watch_outs: Nothing in the posting about hiring contractors outside the US - assume he has to raise remote-from-Italy himself in the first message, and treat a non-answer as a dead end. Small non-tech end client (behaviour-analysis services practice), so no engineering peers; also verify the entity, since the role is hosted on a different company's Greenhouse board. If it goes ahead he would invoice as Partita IVA and needs a W-8BEN.

rows.title: Fractional Senior Full Stack Engineer (Stabilization / AI-Generated Code)
rows.eligibility: Tier 1 - the posting's own location field is "Europe (Remote)" and the engagement is fractional, so no permit or move; a parallel Brazil-located copy of the same role confirms they engage contractors internationally
rows.comp: not disclosed (no compensation fields populated on the Ashby posting API)
rows.why: The scope is taking over AI-generated codebases and stabilising them into something shippable - close to what he actually did leading the Bubble.io to Next.js + Laravel migration of a live product, and to ramping fast on eight different European codebases. Fractional basis means the ~3-year count matters less than whether he can own the cleanup.
rows.watch_outs: Bullpen Talent is a talent marketplace, not the end client - no named company behind the engagement, which is the pattern the profile normally gates out; treat it as a contract-shop channel (same category as G2i) and get the client named before investing time. 62 days old, outside the 30-day freshness preference, and the API's employmentType still reads FullTime despite the "Fractional" title, so confirm hours and rate up front. No rate disclosed.
